detailed_descriptions.en: Jack's monkey has escaped holdings and has thrashed the store. Now he needs you to sleeve all the vinyl records into their jackets and then restored back to their correct musical genre's storage crates! The monkey (named after Jack himself) got his hands on all 20 genres of vinyl records, and has tossed hundreds of vinyl records and their jackets all over the place! Re:Store the Record Store is an atmospheric sorting game set in a cozy indie vinyl record store. Featuring over 1000 vinyl records and jackets to pick up, sleeve and resorted back into the crates where they belong! A day-night cycle alters the shop's atmosphere. Take your time sorting and storing the records! It's not a game to rush through. Or you could if you want to, with abilities such as Genre Glance, Crate Chaser and more! Pick up vinyl records and jackets in first person perspective, slide the vinyl satisfyingly into the correct jacket and then put them back into crates. Made a mistake? You can extract the sleeved vinyl as well! Key Features: Zen Sorting Gameplay: Over 1000 objects to wade and sort through! Get them all back where they belong with no time limit. Humorous Details: Discover punny artist and album names. Every single album's artist name, album name, and jacket art are hand crafted to be as silly or as cool as possible! Interactive objects: There's a cool looking gramophone on the counter top! It must have been placed there for a reason. Hidden secrets: The game doesn't end at sorting all the vinyl records, there are additional things to do to get Steam achievements. What are they? You're gonna have to play and find out!
